summary: E2E frontend test of the admin-driven login carousel (7 scenarios). All PASS: edit by link, style (centre/fort/grand), add+reorder+delete slide, upload PNG (served via /api/medias/<id>), video-by-link (mp4), mobile banner reflects admin config, and final restoration of the 3 original slides. Backend endpoints (public GET, admin PUT, upload, media serving) confirmed working through the UI flows.
critical_code_review_comments: CarrouselLoginAdmin.jsx delete button uses no explicit window.confirm — deletion is immediate on click. Consider a confirmation for accidental delete of a slide the admin spent time filling.
Login.jsx keeps a hardcoded SLIDES_LOGIN fallback array that duplicates the backend SLIDES_DEFAUT — any future change must be mirrored in both places (drift risk).

carrousel_ext.py _normaliser_slide silently coerces invalid style values to defaults instead of raising — admin gets no feedback if they send an unknown position/voile/taille (currently frontend can't do that, but the API contract is lax).
seed_data_creation: None persisted — final scenario restored the 3 original slides (Pilote ton activité avec clarté / Ton bien-être d'abord / Entreprends avec sens) with default style (bas/moyen/normal). Verified on /login after restoration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Selectors verified: pro-menu-carrousel (admin sidebar), carrousel-admin (root), carrousel-slide-{i}, carrousel-titre-{i}, carrousel-desc-{i}, carrousel-src-{i}, carrousel-type-{i} (select image/video), carrousel-mode-lien-{i}/carrousel-mode-upload-{i}, carrousel-file-{i} (hidden input — use set_input_files), carrousel-upload-{i}, carrousel-position-{i}/voile-{i}/taille-{i}, carrousel-up-{i}/down-{i}/del-{i}, carrousel-add, carrousel-save. On /login: login-carousel (desktop only, >=1024px), login-carousel-titre, login-carousel-texte, login-carousel-dot-{i}, login-carousel-mobile (mobile only, <1024px). The desktop carousel auto-rotates every 5s so screenshots should target the active slide via dot click. Upload succeeded via real Emergent objstore in ~3s and was served publicly via /api/medias/<uuid>. Video mp4 rendered as a <video> tag in the carousel. Style 'grand' toggles the title from text-3xl to text-4xl xl:text-5xl.

detailed_results.S1_edit_by_link: PASS — Admin login, opened Carrousel login tab, edited slide 0 title to 'Titre E2E modifié', saved, reopened /login → login-carousel-titre = 'Titre E2E modifié'.
detailed_results.S2_style_centre_fort_grand: PASS — slide 0 position=centre / voile=fort / taille=grand saved; /login login-carousel-titre class contains 'text-4xl' (grand). Screenshot captured.
detailed_results.S3_add_reorder_delete: PASS — 3 slides → clicked carrousel-add → 4 slides; filled slide 3 (link + 'Slide test E2E'), used carrousel-up-3 then carrousel-down-2 to reorder, saved. /login shows login-carousel-dot-3. Deleted the test slide via carrousel-del (auto-accepted dialog) and saved → back to 3 slides.
detailed_results.S4_upload: PASS — carrousel-mode-upload-0 → set_input_files on carrousel-file-0 with a 400x300 PNG → '✓ fichier téléversé' indicator visible → saved → /login image src = https://wellbeing-onboard.preview.emergentagent.com/api/medias/<uuid> (real object storage).
detailed_results.S5_video_link: PASS — slide 1 type=video, src=https://www.w3schools.com/html/mov_bbb.mp4, saved. On /login clicked login-carousel-dot-1 → <video> element present inside login-carousel.
detailed_results.S6_mobile_banner: PASS — 375px viewport /login, login-carousel-mobile visible and its title text reflects the admin config (contained 'Titre E2E modifié' from slide 0).
detailed_results.S7_restoration: PASS — restored 3 slides with original Unsplash URLs, titles, descriptions, all style bas/moyen/normal. Saved. /login final title = 'Pilote ton activité avec clarté', exactly 3 dots.
